documents.prompt: The generated data include $(0,{{y0}})$. Use linear-regression technology to WRITE the fitted function $y=mx+b$, then predict $y$ when $x=6$.

solutionReview.headline: Regression produces the equation before the prediction.
reasoning: Use linear regression on all five points and record both the slope and intercept in $y=mx+b$.
Substitute the requested input into that fitted equation, then decide whether the prediction is interpolation or extrapolation.

attemptFeedback: Do not predict until you have written both regression coefficients.
supportHints: Use all data points in the regression; a line through only two selected points is not the requested fitted model.
